plain: Showing signs that success is likely.

webster.text: Having omens of success, or favorable appearances; as an auspicious beginning.

example.quote: If the banishment of an alien from a country into which he has been invited as the asylum most auspicious to his happiness,—a country where he may have formed the most tender connections;
example.cite: James Madison, Report on the Virginia Resolutions (Report of 1800), Jan. 7, 1800
